scripts.build: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run build --prefix web" "npm run build --prefix api"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run start:dev --prefix api"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run lint --prefix web --fix" "npm run lint --prefix api"
